dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: Don't tell me you haven't heard of Alain Guillotin!? He was a great engineer who lived a few centuries ago. He was the one who set up the Fontaine Research Institute! Those lifts I told you about were all built to his designs.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: It's a shame he never had any children or close friends. Apparently, he had a bunch of important discoveries that were stolen after his death.

dialogues.speaker: Langemak
dialogues.text: *sigh* What sort of a person steals research papers?
